title: Selected Topics in Information Processing; Federated Learning
description:
Prerequisite: ENEE436 or CMSC422; or students who have taken courses with comparable content may contact the Department. Cross-listed with ENEE759Z. Credit only granted for ENEE759Z or CMSC848Z.

Principles and applications of federated learning. Federated optimization, statistical and system homogeneity models, variations of federated aggregation, security and privacy considerations, foundation models.
